title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
firstLine: “Christmas won’t be Christmas without any presents,” grumbled Jo, lying on the rug.
begins: Chapter One finds the four March sisters by the fire on a snowy December evening, grumbling about having no presents. Their father is away where the fighting is. The girls decide to spend their dollar each on gifts for their mother.
happens: The four March sisters grow up poor, with their mother, Marmee, while their father is away at the war. Meg is courted by John Brooke, the tutor of their neighbour Laurie, and marries him. Jo, who writes, refuses Laurie's proposal and goes to New York, where she meets Professor Bhaer. Beth, who is gentle and musical, falls ill and dies. Laurie marries Amy, whom he meets in Nice during her travels. Jo marries Professor Bhaer, and together they open a school for boys at Plumfield, a house left to Jo by Aunt March.

characters.name: Jo March
characters.who: second sister, a tomboy and writer
